data.title: Chat: favicon AC-3 guard — read single-quoted paint attributes and reject SMIL colour doors (AS-28 F4/F5, test-only)

data.body: CONTEXT (filed by cto-owen from Priya's AS-28 cycle-2 review, loop tick 8). Test-only. F4: the AC-3 palette guard in apps/chat/test/api.test.js reads only double-quoted paint attributes, so stroke="#1C41E3" plus fill='red' survives at 370/370 — one regex alternation for the quote. F5: SMIL <set attributeName="fill" to="red"/> and <animate> are colour doors the guard does not read — one 'no set/animate elements' assertion. Both must be added as named falsifiers (M4) observed red on a scratch copy; the guard's existing six falsifiers stay red. Priya's exact fixes are in her AS-28 cycle-2 review comment. Records only, no fix: fill="none" and #fff are rejected (safe direction, matches the guard's stated strictness); fill-opacity="0" passes (outside AC-3's claim). Low priority; tag chat.

Planned (cto-owen, tick watcher:78911 loop tick 19; planning lane ran on Opus — the Fable spawn was refused at HTTP 429). Plan adopts Priya's F4/F5 fixes: quote alternation in the AC-3 paint regex (T3) plus a separate SMIL-element ban test (T4, the closed SVG animation-element list, six names) — separate so the suite count moves by +1 (stale-image detector). Base host 605/603/0/2 on master dd6a41e; predicted branch 606/604/0/2, compose 606/598/0/8. 15 mutant runs (13 + 2 master-file controls), red sets in plan §2. Implementer Lena (her guard), reviewer Ruben (Priya authored the fix; must not receive §2's red sets as observed results). Branch feat/AS-109-favicon-guard-quotes-smil linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-109 added.

Implementation done — one commit b01b4b8 on feat/AS-109-favicon-guard-quotes-smil, api.test.js only (diff --stat: 1 file, +18/-2; favicon.svg byte-identical to master). T3 paint regex now (?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)') with value = dq ?? sq; T4 'api: AS-109 — the favicon carries no SMIL animation element' is a separate test banning the closed six (set|animate|animateColor|animateMotion|animateTransform|discard), message names the element found.

MUTANTS — 15 runs on a detached scratch worktree /tmp/AS-109-mutant (host node --test, full suite each), 13 mutants + 2 master-file controls; every one applied-at-site asserted (grep-count 0->1 on the anchored line, diff HEAD --name-only = favicon.svg [+ api.test.js for controls]), restored with checkout HEAD -- . and status --porcelain empty between runs. Observed red sets, all exactly as §2 predicted (0 mismatches): M1-control (master's test file) all green 605/603 — the hole; M1 red {T3} '5 paint attributes examined: fill="red" is not a palette token'; M2 red {T3} via the VALUE message at '4 paint attributes examined: fill="red"' (not the floor); M3 all green 606/604 — single-quoted #FFFFFF read and accepted; M4-control (master's test file) all green 605/603 — the hole; M4 red {T4} 'found <set>'; M5 red {T4} 'found <animate>'; M6 red {T4} 'found <animateTransform>'; M3a red {T3} fill="#FF0000"; M3b red {T3} fill="none"; M3c red {T3} fill="red" with comment intact; M3d red {T3} fill="#1C41E3FF"; M3e red {T3} '0 paint attributes examined, expected at least 4'; M3f red {T3} 'declares no style="" attribute'. T4 green on every T3 mutant and T3 green on every T4 mutant. Two EXTRA observations beyond the 15 (plan says 'quote both'): M2 and M3 against master's test file are each red {T3} via the floor '3 paint attributes examined' — the single-quoted attribute is invisible to master's regex. Zero survivors, so no diff re-reads were needed.

One note, not a finding against the guard: plan §2 quotes the A-path tail as '…v-4z"/>' but favicon.svg line 5 ends '…1 4-4z"/>' — my first M4 replace did not apply and the site-assertion refused to run the suite (the rule working as written); the runner anchors on '-4z"/>' (occurs once, line 5). Ruben: check the anchor text before trusting a string replace there.

COUNTS (cardinality first). Master baseline, same tick: host 605 tests / 603 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped (matches §0); compose --project asc-impl-as109-base, 'Image asc-impl-as109-base-test Built', 605 / 597 / 0 / 8 (§4's predicted shape, now measured). Branch tip b01b4b8: host 606 / 604 / 0 / 2; compose --project asc-impl-as109, 'Image asc-impl-as109-test Built', 606 / 598 / 0 / 8 — +1 on both, T3 and T4 both listed as passing inside the container. Both compose runs via bin/compose-run.mjs (forces --build, tears down), leak check clean.

Cleanup: /tmp/AS-109-mutant removed (git worktree remove --force), no /tmp/AS-109-* left, compose-run --check 'no leftovers' (3 production networks only), $W status --porcelain empty. Runner script and logs in scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-109/ (mutants.mjs, mutants.log, host-*.log, compose-*.log/.receipt). Not touched: AS-111/AS-112 worktrees, /tmp/AS-112-mutant (Marcus's). Status left for the orchestrator to move to review.

VERDICT: implementation-level rework needed. Reviewer agent:qa-ruben (on Opus under the Fable-usage fallback), tick watcher:78911 loop tick 21. Read the plan and the diff (master...feat/AS-109-favicon-guard-quotes-smil, HEAD b01b4b8) cold; ran my own battery on a detached scratch worktree; read Lena's implementation comment LAST, after the findings below were formed. Every acceptance criterion on the floor passes; the block comes from the M6 probe budget plan §3 explicitly set aside, under its own rule ('an honest-mistake survivor is blocking').

FINDINGS (1 blocking, 3 records outside the criteria list, 1 record against my own runner):

F1 [BLOCKING, defect, M6 probe P1 — implementation-level] A shape element with no paint attribute at all passes T3. Repro on the scratch copy: append '  <circle cx="16" cy="20" r="2"/>' as line 9 of public/favicon.svg (applied-assertion 0->1 at line 9, diff --stat = favicon.svg only) -> host 606/604/0/2, ALL GREEN. SVG's initial fill is black, so a black dot ships in the artwork with zero non-palette attributes for the paint loop to read; the floor (>=4) is one-directional and cannot see a fifth shape. This is a single careless edit — add a dot, forget fill= — not an entity trick or a mixed-quote two-step, and it is named neither in this plan nor in Priya's AS-28 F4-F7. By the standard Priya applied on AS-28 ('every single-edit variant is red') and by this plan's §3 sentence, it blocks. The plan's approach is sound and the diff does exactly what §1 asks; the fix is a few lines in the same test, hence implementation-level. Proposed fix (test-only, in T3, placed AFTER the existing paint loop so M3e keeps its AS-28 message '0 paint attributes examined'): collect every shape element /<(path|circle|ellipse|rect|line|polyline|polygon|text)\b([^>]*)>/g, assert shapes >= 4 (cardinality), and assert each carries its own fill= attribute (no inheritance in a 9-line file; safe direction), message naming the tag. Named falsifier for the rework: P1 observed red exactly {T3} with the message naming <circle>; M3 must stay green; M1/M2, M4-M6, M3a-f red sets unchanged; P1 against the current branch file is the control (green, observed by me).

N1 [non-blocking, convention -> plan owner cto-owen] Plan §2's M4 anchor text '…v-4z"/>' does not occur in favicon.svg (line 5 ends '1 4-4z"/>'). A replace keyed on it is a no-op: my applied-assertion aborted the run (0->0, empty diff --stat) and I re-anchored on '4-4z"/>'. Not a defect in the code; recorded because an unapplied mutant looks exactly like a passing guard, and this time the assertion did its job.

N2 [non-blocking, record] T4 carries no presence or cardinality assertion of its own: an empty or 404 body passes it. In-suite it is covered by the AS-28 content-type test and T3's floor, so this is not a vacuous pass today; a one-line assert that the artwork contains '<svg' would make T4 self-sufficient. Fold into the F1 rework or leave; implementer's call.

N3 [record, adversarial survivors -> §1 out-of-scope list] P9: a <filter><feColorMatrix type="hueRotate" values="180"/></filter> plus filter="url(#f)" on the path recolours the artwork with no paint attribute -> green. P11: <svg:set …/> with xmlns:svg bound on the root -> green (the T4 regex requires '<' directly before the name). Neither is a hand edit a designer would produce; both confirm the out-of-scope list and should be added to it (filters; namespace-prefixed element names). P10 (a <set> inside an XML comment) is green and correctly so — comments do not render.

N4 [record, my own runner] My first battery pass ran master's api.test.js on every 'branch' run: after the master-file control, 'git checkout -- .' restores from an index that 'checkout master -- <file>' had rewritten. The tell was 'tests 605' instead of 606 on every run — cardinality-before-quantification caught it before a single red set was recorded. Fixed the restore to 'reset --hard HEAD'; the bad pass was discarded, though it incidentally supplied the plan's 'on master, M2 and M3 are red via the floor at 3' observations (both seen).

SWEEP — floor check, 8 of 8 pass; 1 finding outside the list (F1), 3 records outside it (N1-N3):
- AC-1 PASS. M1 (path +stroke="#1C41E3", circle 1 fill='red') red exactly {T3} '5 paint attributes examined: fill="red" is not a palette token'; M1 against master's api.test.js all green 605/603/0/2 (the hole). M2 (fill='red' alone) red {T3} via the VALUE message at '4 paint attributes examined', not the floor.
- AC-2 PASS. M4 <set> red exactly {T4} 'found <set>'; M5 <animate> red {T4} 'found <animate>'; M6 <animateTransform> red {T4} 'found <animateTransform>'. T3 green on all three. M4 against master's api.test.js all green 605/603/0/2 (the hole). T4's list is a literal, six names: set, animate, animateColor, animateMotion, animateTransform, discard.
- AC-3 PASS. M3 (fill='#FFFFFF') all green 606/604/0/2 — the alternation reads, not merely rejects.
- AC-4 PASS. M3a #FF0000, M3b fills->none file-wide, M3c red/lime with comment intact, M3d #1C41E3FF: each red exactly {T3} via the value message; M3e every paint removed: red {T3} '0 paint attributes examined, expected at least 4'; M3f style="fill:red": red {T3} 'no style="" attribute'. T4 green on all six.
- AC-5 PASS. Host from $W: 606 tests / 604 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped. Compose branch tip via bin/compose-run.mjs --project asc-review-as109: 'Image asc-review-as109-test Built', 606 / 598 / 0 / 8. Compose master baseline, same tick, --project asc-review-as109-master: 'Image asc-review-as109-master-test Built', 605 / 597 / 0 / 8. +1 on both; T3 and T4 both listed passing inside the container.
- AC-6 PASS. 15 runs (13 mutants + 2 master-file controls), all on /tmp/AS-109-mutant (detached, never $W), every one applied-asserted at the intended line and diff --stat = favicon.svg only, scratch tree proven clean after each; 11 red, M3 green, 2 controls green — red sets EXACT to §2, 0 deviations. Plus 11 probes: 7 red (P2 <g fill='red'> inherited, P3 'fill = 'red'' spaced, P4 currentColor, P5 fill='', P6 <SET> uppercase, P7 <set + newline, P8 gradient stop-color='#FF00AA' -> '6 paint attributes examined'), 1 expected green (P10), 3 survivors (P1 = F1, P9/P11 = N3).
- AC-7 PASS. diff --stat master...: apps/chat/test/api.test.js only, +18/-2; favicon.svg, server.js, index.html byte-identical to master (empty diff).
- AC-8 PASS. /tmp/AS-109-mutant removed (worktree remove --force); compose-run --check 'no leftovers' (3 production networks only) before and after; $W diff --exit-code clean, status --porcelain empty. Logs under scratchpad/agent-qa-ruben/AS-109/ (battery.mjs, runs/*.log, compose-*.log).

§7.2 (T4 as a separate test): agreed — the +1 count moved on both host and compose and is the cheapest stale-image tell available; not a rework note. Seams: master's apps/ unchanged since the plan baseline dd6a41e; merge-tree against c27c4f5 clean. Nothing fixed inline; nothing committed; status untouched for the orchestrator.

Routed review -> in_progress (rework cycle 1) on Ruben's implementation-level verdict. Findings appended to the plan under 'Review Cycle 1 Findings': F1 (a paintless shape survives T3 — add a per-shape fill= assertion after the paint loop, P1 as the named falsifier), N1 re-anchor for the §2 M4 mutant, N2 optional, N3 to the out-of-scope list. Lena picks it up next tick in .worktrees/AS-109 on feat/AS-109-favicon-guard-quotes-smil; Ruben reviews cycle 2. Tick watcher:78911 loop tick 21.

Rework cycle 1 implementation stage opened (Owen, tick watcher:57637 loop tick 22). Lena applies Ruben's F1 fix per the plan's Review Cycle 1 section (every shape carries its own fill=, shapes>=4 floor, P1 the named falsifier), on feat/AS-109-favicon-guard-quotes-smil in .worktrees/AS-109; Ruben reviews cycle 2 next tick.

Rework cycle 1 done (developer-lena, tick watcher:57637 loop tick 22) — one commit 93f6c68 on feat/AS-109-favicon-guard-quotes-smil atop b01b4b8; api.test.js only (diff --stat master...HEAD: 1 file, +39/-2; favicon.svg untouched). F1 fix in T3, placed AFTER the paint loop as Ruben specified: collect /<(path|circle|ellipse|rect|line|polyline|polygon|text)\b([^>]*)>/g, assert shapes >= 4 ('N shape elements examined, expected at least 4'), then assert each carries /\sfill\s*=/ with the message 'N shape elements examined: <tag> carries no fill= attribute of its own'. N2 folded in: T4 now asserts the body contains '<svg' before it asserts what is absent. No new test, so the suite count does not move this cycle (the F1 assertion lives inside T3).

MUTANTS — 17 runs on a detached scratch worktree /tmp/AS-109-mutant at 93f6c68 (host node --test, full suite each; restore = reset --hard HEAD per Ruben's N4; M4 anchored on '-4z"/>' per N1), every one applied-at-site asserted (grep-count 0->1 at the anchored line, diff --name-only = favicon.svg [+ api.test.js for controls]), scratch proven clean between runs. 0 mismatches. P1-control (Ruben's paintless '<circle cx="16" cy="20" r="2"/>' at L9 against the PRE-FIX branch test file b01b4b8): all green 606/604/0/2 — the hole, reproduced. P1 (same edit against 93f6c68): red exactly {T3}, '5 shape elements examined: <circle> carries no fill= attribute of its own'. The 15 §2 runs unchanged from cycle 0: M1-control green; M1 red {T3} '5 paint attributes examined: fill="red"'; M2 red {T3} via the VALUE message at 4; M3 all green 606/604 (single-quoted #FFFFFF accepted — the shape check reads the raw attribute blob, so quote style is invisible to it); M4-control green; M4 red {T4} 'found <set>'; M5 red {T4} 'found <animate>'; M6 red {T4} 'found <animateTransform>'; M3a/b/c/d red {T3} via the value message; M3e red {T3} '0 paint attributes examined' — the paint floor still fires first, as required; M3f red {T3} 'declares no style'. T4 green on every T3 mutant, T3 green on every T4 mutant.

One cardinality deviation, explained, not a finding: the two master-file controls read 606 tests this cycle where cycle 0 read 605. Master's api.test.js gained exactly one test since the branch point dd6a41e — AS-111 F1 'api-events-since-resolves-before-task-filter' (610dfe9, merged 4c1cb2b) — so 606 minus T4 plus 1 = 606. Both controls still assert the swapped-in file carries no AS-109 marker.

COUNTS (cardinality first), branch tip 93f6c68: host 606 tests / 604 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped; compose via bin/compose-run.mjs --project asc-impl-as109-c1, 'Image asc-impl-as109-c1-test Built', 606 / 598 / 0 / 8, T3 and T4 both listed passing inside the container. Same as cycle 0's branch figures, as expected (+0 tests). Cleanup: /tmp/AS-109-mutant removed (worktree remove --force), no /tmp/AS-109-*, compose-run --check 'no leftovers' (3 production networks only), worktree status --porcelain empty, worktree list = master + AS-109 only. Logs: scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-109/ (mutants.mjs, mutants-c1.log, host-branch-c1.log, compose-branch-c1.log/.receipt). Ruben's scratchpad not read.

PROPOSED PLAN WORDING (N3, for the plan owner — the plan is board state, not mine to edit). Append to §1 'Out of scope': "filter effects (a <filter><feColorMatrix .../></filter> plus filter=\"url(#f)\" recolours the artwork with no paint attribute — Ruben's P9), and namespace-prefixed element names (<svg:set .../> with xmlns:svg bound on the root — Ruben's P11; T4 requires '<' directly before the name). Both adversarial, neither a careless hand edit." And a one-line §1 addendum for the fix now in the code: "Cycle-1 F1: every shape element carries its own fill= and the shape count has a >=4 floor; the paint floor stays first so M3e keeps its message." Status left for Owen to move to review.

Review cycle 2 opened (Owen, tick watcher:57637 loop tick 23). Reviewer: qa-ruben, fresh context, scratchpad/agent-qa-ruben/AS-109/. Battery per the Review Cycle 1 section: 16 runs (15 §2 with the N1 re-anchor + P1).

VERDICT: PASS, merge. Reviewer agent:qa-ruben, cycle 2 of 3, tick watcher:57637 loop tick 23, on Opus (Fable fallback). Read cold: plan incl. my own Review Cycle 1 section, then the diff; my battery and probes ran and my findings were written before I read Lena's 'Rework cycle 1 done' comment — read LAST, then cross-checked (her host/compose/mutant figures match mine exactly; her master-control 606 vs my 605 is explained below, N6). Nothing fixed inline; no commits by me.

FINDINGS (0 blocking, 3 notes; all outside the criteria list):
N4 [record -> plan §1 out-of-scope, and a small follow-up task for the plan owner] A CSS filter function in a presentation attribute is a colour door T3/T4 do not see: probe P3, circle 1 given filter="drop-shadow(0 0 1px red)" (no <filter> element) -> all green on the branch. Same channel as Lena's feColorMatrix note and my cycle-1 N3, one step more careless: no defs, one attribute. Not a slip — a shadow is a deliberate addition — so under §3's own rule it is a record, not a block, and not worth cycle 3. But BRANDING §7.A.5 (and line 554) forbid drop shadows outright, so the ban is cheap and justified: beside the two style bans, assert.ok(!/<filter[\s>]|\sfilter\s*=/i.test(artwork), 'the artwork declares no filter element or attribute'), falsifier = P3 red exactly {T3}. Recommend Owen files it as a Chat-set follow-up rather than reopening this branch. Lena's proposed §1 wording should read 'filter effects — <filter>/feColorMatrix, or a CSS filter function in filter= — ' so both spellings are named.
N5 [wording, non-blocking] The F1 shape guard rejects a legitimate all-palette stroke-only <line> (probe P2: <line x1="4" y1="28" x2="28" y2="28" stroke="#1C41E3" stroke-width="2"/> -> red '5 shape elements examined: <line> carries no fill= attribute'). Safe direction and a stated strictness (with F6 rejecting none, a line can only pass with a harmless palette fill=), but the message's 'renders black' is untrue for line/polyline (no interior). Leave as is; noted so the next editor is not misled.
N6 [record] My three swapped-file controls used the merge-base copy of api.test.js (dd6a41e, 605 tests) rather than current master's (606 — AS-111 F1 landed in that file since the branch point); Lena's used master's. Both prove the same thing (no AS-109 fix present -> M1/M4 green, M3 red via the floor); recording the substitution so the two comments' control counts are not read as a discrepancy.

SEAM CHECK (what else was in flight): master added 60 lines to api.test.js since dd6a41e (AS-111 610dfe9, AS-112 9d70ae6/f583933), none near line 1447. git merge-tree master..branch: clean auto-merge. Merged tree run (scratch, merge --no-commit then abort): host 613 / 611 / 0 / 2 = master 612 + 1. Post-merge expectation for the tick: host 613/611/0/2.

- diff --stat master...HEAD: apps/chat/test/api.test.js | 41 (+39/-2), 1 file. favicon.svg: empty diff vs master (byte-identical). AC-7 met.
- Host ($W/apps/chat, node --test): 606 tests / 604 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped. Base 605 + 1 (T4). Not carrying the plan's number; measured.
- Compose (node apps/chat/bin/compose-run.mjs --project asc-review-as109-c2 --cwd $W/apps/chat): 'Image asc-review-as109-c2-test Built', tests=606 pass=598 fail=0 skipped=8, run exit 0, down exit 0, leak check clean. T3 (log line 98) and T4 (line 99) both listed passing inside the image.

MUTATION BATTERY — 17 runs, detached scratch /tmp/AS-109-mutant at 93f6c68, full host suite per run, never $W. Per run: token count 0->1 at the anchored line asserted, git diff HEAD --name-only = favicon.svg (+ api.test.js for the three swapped-file controls), restore, git diff HEAD --exit-code clean. 17/17 red sets exactly as predicted, 0 mismatches, 0 survivors. Observed messages:
M1-control (base test file): green 605/603/0/2 — the F4 hole. M1: {T3} '5 paint attributes examined: fill="red" is not a palette token'. M2: {T3} '4 paint attributes examined: fill="red" …' (value message, not floor). M3-on-base: {T3} '3 paint attributes examined, expected at least 4'. M3: GREEN 606/604/0/2 — single-quoted palette value read and accepted. M4-control: green. M4 (re-anchored 4-4z"/> per N1): {T4} 'found <set>'. M5: {T4} 'found <animate>'. M6: {T4} 'found <animateTransform>'. M3a/M3b/M3c/M3d: {T3} value message. M3e: {T3} '0 paint attributes examined, expected at least 4' (paint floor still first, as F1's fix required). M3f: {T3} 'the artwork declares no style="" attribute'. P1 (paintless <circle cx="16" cy="20" r="2"/> as line 9): {T3} '5 shape elements examined: <circle> carries no fill= attribute of its own'. P1-control (unmutated branch file): green 606/604/0/2. T4 green on every T3 mutant and vice versa.

M6 PROBES (14, favicon-subset runs, probes.log): P2 line false-positive (N5); P3 filter survivor (N4); P4 paintless circle with aria-label="fill=x" -> RED via F1 (the \sfill anchor needs whitespace before fill, so an in-value fill= does not count — tighter than I assumed); P5 <g fill='red'> wrapping the circles -> RED 5 paints fill="red"; P6 FILL="#FFFFFF" uppercase -> RED floor 3; P7 fill="currentColor"+color="red" -> RED; P8 <svg fill="red"> root -> RED; P9 shape inside an XML comment -> GREEN (stripped, not counted, correct); P10 <circle …></circle> open form -> GREEN, correct; P11a <set> in a comment -> GREEN; P11b <SET> uppercase -> RED 'found <SET>'; P12 gradient with stop-color="red" + fill="url(#g)" -> RED stop-color; P13 <textPath>/<linearGradient> substrings with real shapes cut to 3 -> RED '3 shape elements examined' (substrings not counted); P14 fill="#FFF" -> RED (F6, safe); P15 fill="" -> RED. Shape list is a literal at api.test.js:1497 (8 names); SMIL list a literal at :1522 (6 names).

FLOOR CHECK (acceptance sweep, second by design — 9/9 pass, with the 3 notes above outside the list): AC-1 M1 red {T3} on branch, green on the base file; M2 red via the value message at 4 — PASS. AC-2 M4/M5/M6 each red exactly {T4}, M4 green on the base file — PASS. AC-3 M3 all green on the branch — PASS. AC-4 M3a–f each red exactly {T3} with the AS-28 messages, T4 green — PASS. AC-5 host 606/604/0/2, compose 606/598/0/8 with the Built line — PASS. AC-6 15 §2 runs + P1 + control = 17, red sets exact, applied-assertions recorded per run — PASS. AC-7 api.test.js only, favicon byte-identical — PASS. AC-8 /tmp/AS-109-mutant removed, compose-run --check 'no leftovers' (3 production networks only), $W diff --exit-code clean — PASS. F1's named falsifier (P1 red {T3} naming <circle>, M3 still green, all other red sets unchanged) — PASS. §7.2 (T4 as a separate test): the split is right; the +1 count is what let me see the branch tip against its base at a glance.
